description: A sprite sheet of FOUR separate staircases arranged in a grid of 2 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top left: glass conservatory mansion: white wrought iron steps with leaf patterns, white curly iron handrail and balusters, slender white iron newel posts with glass lamp tops. Top right: ice palace: translucent pale blue ice steps, clear crystal handrail and icicle balusters, ice newel posts topped with glowing crystals. Bottom left: Haven villa: white marble steps with gold edging, gold handrail and ornate gold balusters, white marble newel posts with gold orbs. Bottom right: country cottage: warm honey oak steps, oak handrail and simple turned balusters, oak newel posts with round caps. Each cell holds ONE indoor staircase seen from the side exactly like the reference: a straight flight of six steps rising from the lower left to the upper right, a closed side panel under the steps, a handrail on balusters following the steps, a tall newel post at the bottom left and another at the top right, standing on a flat bottom line. Same size, viewing angle, chunky pixel blocks, thick dark outline and soft cel shading as the reference. Every staircase centered in its own cell with empty space around it, on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background. No text, no letters, no floor, no wall, no people, no animals.

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style and the staircase shape of this reference: side view, six steps rising left to right, handrail, two newel posts, chunky pixel blocks, thick dark outline. Change materials and colours as described.
